name: wordmark type-on with fanned photo collage
looks: A loose arc of small photo cards hangs on the left in soft shadow. On the right, a headline types on character by character with a blinking cursor, then a plain subtitle line crossfades in underneath once the typing stops.
build: DOM photo cards pre-placed with small random rotation (kit.rng seed) and a soft drop shadow; headline revealed with kit.typeOn at a steady rate; subtitle fades/rises 4-6px in on power2.out after a short pause once the cursor stops.
sound: A light typing clack per character, then a soft swell under the subtitle fade.
prompt: Open on a loose arc of small reference images in soft shadow to one side, while a short headline types itself on with a blinking cursor on the other side, and a plain one-line subtitle fades in underneath once the typing settles. Use the brand's own display font and a calm, open field.
